title: Missed Appointment (No-Show) Fee Policy, In-Person Appointments
content:
1. **Closing as a no-show.** An In-Person Appointments visit closes as a no-show when the patient neither cancelled nor was checked in by the end of the clinic session.
2. **Condition for assessing the fee.** A no-show fee is assessed only when the visit's status is no-show. The status is read from the appointment's own system record, for that appointment.
3. **Amount.** The sentence *"The no-show fee is the visit type's no-show fee figure"* is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the no-show fee a missed visit carries. The visit type's no-show fee figure itself stays as published in the fee schedule.
4. **First offense.** Where the visit type waives the first no-show and the patient has no prior no-shows of the same visit type, the fee is not charged: the waiver is recorded instead with the reason first offense, and no fee entry is made. Prior no-shows are counted over a rolling window of the visit type's look-back in calendar months ending on the scheduled date of the missed visit, excluding that visit itself, and are the patient's other appointments of the same visit type whose status is no-show and whose scheduled date falls inside the window.
5. **Medicaid Managed Care Account.** When the patient's billing account was on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the scheduled date, no no-show or late-cancellation fee is ever charged; the waiver is recorded with the reason Medicaid prohibition.
6. **Precedence.** The Medicaid prohibition takes precedence over the first-offense waiver, and either one excludes the fee entirely; the two are never stacked with a partial fee.
7. **Deposit.** A held booking deposit is forfeited toward the fee under the booking deposit terms.

### Decision table

| Account tier on the scheduled date | Visit type waives the first no-show | Prior no-shows of the same visit type in the window | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | any | any | Not charged; waiver recorded with reason Medicaid prohibition |
| Any other tier | Yes | 0 | Not charged; waiver recorded with reason first offense, no fee entry |
| Any other tier | Yes | 1 or more | Fee charged |
| Any other tier | No | any | Fee charged |

*Hypothetical:* a patient on the Commercial PPO/POS Account tier misses an In-Office Procedure Visit, a visit type that does not waive the first no-show; the first-offense waiver does not apply, whatever the prior count.

superseded_clauses: The no-show fee is the visit type's no_show_fee_usd.
